date_published.why: The quote is the rule file date with the Department of State; the Board's adoption vote was on 16 Sep 2026 (press release). Filing date is a defensible issue date and the notes give both.

summary_claims.claim: by 1 Jul 2027 boards must amend policy; parent notice and opt-in with non-AI alternative; extra review for VPK-5
adult supervision, complete log and shut-off for agentic AI; human review of AI decisions; disclosure of unexpected autonomous behaviour or security incidents to the Department
no student data used to train commercial AI models; ban on AI simulating friendship or meeting emotional needs

scope.note: Binding state rule on AI safety in schools.

note: Status 'Adopted, not yet in force' is right as of 14 Oct 2026 (effective 29 Oct 2026).
